Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the human adenosine A3 receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name to 'Adenosine A3 receptor' and target_dictionary.organism to 'Homo sapiens', and filter assays.assay_organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
